target.title: fix(qqbot): soft-wrap exec approval command preview for desktop QQ
target.body:
## Summary

- Soft-wraps the shell command shown in QQ Bot exec approval messages so it wraps inside the code block.
- Approvers on desktop QQ can read the full command at a glance instead of dragging a horizontal scrollbar before approving.

## Motivation

Closes #101979.

Desktop QQ renders fenced code blocks as a single horizontally scrollable line and does not soft-wrap long content, while mobile QQ wraps automatically. As a result, a long command in an exec approval preview was only partially visible on desktop, making it hard to review before approving. The fix hard-wraps the (already length-capped) command preview at a bounded width before it is placed in the code fence, so the whole command is visible on desktop and still correct on mobile.

## Verification

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/qqbot/src/engine/approval/index.test.ts` — 8 passed.
  - New `wrapCommandPreview` unit tests: short lines unchanged, long lines hard-wrapped ≤ width and losslessly round-trip, existing newlines preserved, non-positive width disables wrapping.
  - New `buildExecApprovalText` test proves a 120-char command is wrapped so no code-block line exceeds the wrap width.
  - Existing UTF-16-boundary truncation test updated to strip wrap newlines; still proves the surrogate pair is not split.

## Notes

- Wrapping is applied after the existing `truncateUtf16Safe(cmd, 300)` cap, so it never lengthens the underlying command content — it only inserts line breaks for display.
- `wrapCommandPreview` is exported for direct unit testing and future reuse.
